Title Settings verification - 2026-10-28
Explicit owner feature request; not a newly discovered defect or a completion
claim for a broader GitHub issue. Related menu/audio issues reviewed first.
Based on latest origin/master (1994a5e), unrelated owner notes stashed.

Title and pause menus now expose Settings rather than Sound and Flashing rows.
Settings contains Music, Sound Effects, Flashing, Fog of war / Pure darkness,
and Back. Fog of war is the first/default mode and retains dim explored memory.
Pure darkness suppresses explored memory in the renderer. Its developer-only
control moved here; old hot-reload preference carries over once.

Sliders support click/drag, keyboard arrows and -/=, independent 0..100 levels,
clamped endpoints, persisted localStorage and M master mute. Adjusting a slider
unmutes sound. Music affects the music bus; Sound Effects affects effects,
ambience and UI buses, retaining catalog balance and dynamic ducking. Legacy
master volume migrates to both levels. No sample/music content is added.

Back/Escape returns to the originating title/pause screen. A paused run stays
frozen; pause audio suspension/ducking and the current run track are retained.
Title Settings uses title music and excludes cave ambience. New screen and
settings fields are additive; idempotent migration shifts legacy menu focus.

Verification:
- npm run check passes full suite, assets, UI assets and architecture guards.
- npm run build passes TypeScript and production bundling.
- Pure checks cover old saves, independent levels, clamping, all option saves,
  both return routes, idempotent migration, legacy seed focus/darkness choice.
- Real main host: mouse drag/click, keyboard focus and slider adjustment,
  reload persistence, frozen paused steps, actual bus targets and clean HMR.
- Observed targets at Music 75%, Effects 25%: music .309375, ambience .028125,
  effects .05625, UI .04375 (perceptual squared curve + catalog balance).
- Browser sizes: 320x240, 640x360, 960x540, 1280x720, 1920x1080.
- Production export: Settings works, Music 0 leaves Effects 70 intact, no dev UI
  without opt-in. Memory canvas available in Fog of war, absent in Pure darkness.
- Browser consoles clean; native UI panel/button/font styling retained.

Owner override supersedes old sound-cycle / single-master menu specifications.
No docs snapshot edits; owner knowledge-base resync is needed for this UI change.
IN PROGRESS / awaiting owner visual confirmation of the requested settings.
